inputs.utterance: Classify each return with a human-readable reason instead of numeric codes — map code 0 to 'Wrong Item', 1 to 'Defective', 2 to 'Damaged in Transit', 3 to 'Size/Fit Issue', 4 to 'Changed Mind', and 5 to 'Other'

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: CASE [Return Reason Code] WHEN 0 THEN 'Wrong Item' WHEN 1 THEN 'Defective' WHEN 2 THEN 'Damaged in Transit' WHEN 3 THEN 'Size/Fit Issue' WHEN 4 THEN 'Changed Mind' WHEN 5 THEN 'Other' END
